sql:
SELECT t1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS t1
JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.CDSCode = t2.CDSCode
WHERE t1.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
AND t2.County = 'Alameda'
AND t2.District = 'Fremont Unified'
AND t2.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
